blocks.x: How Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust rewires Insurance & Risk — underwriting precision, claims velocity and reserving discipline — engineered on governed data, engineered for audit.

In Insurance & Risk, cybersecurity & zero-trust covers architecture-level security programs: zero-trust network and workload design, identity modernization, threat intelligence and managed detection, cloud posture management, ai-specific security for models and agents, cyber resilience, and the compliance machinery (soc 2, iso 27001, pci dss, dora) that regulated industries must evidence. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: zero-trust architecture & implementation, threat intelligence & managed soc, identity & access modernization — delivered on Tele Medicine Platform and Driisti Smart Vision Glasses with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Health and financial records concentrate breach value; carrier cyber programs face both attacker interest and regulatory scrutiny on safeguarding. Third-party ecosystems (TPAs, brokers) extend the attack surface.

FNOL packets, medical reports, repair estimates and police files arrive as unstructured documents; manual triage queues claims for days before an adjuster sees them. Leakage and customer patience both bleed in the queue.

GLM-based pricing, telematics factors and external data enrichment multiply model complexity faster than validation capacity. Filings get challenged; model risk documentation is reconstructed under exam pressure.

blocks.x: How we deliver it in this sector

The delivery pattern composes 7 services from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower — Zero-Trust Architecture & Implementation, Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC, Identity & Access Modernization, Cloud Security & Posture Management as the usual core — sequenced through the Achala Method with sector controls: IFRS 17 / LDTI accounting obligations shape the design from the first sprint.
Services we deploy in this sector

items: Never trust, always verify — zero-trust as an executable architecture, not a slide.
Detection that keeps pace — intelligence-driven SOC with the boring parts (tuning, coverage) done properly.
Identity as the perimeter — workforce, customer and machine identities on one governed plane.
Secure at the control plane — posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform.
classification-aware DLP, encryption policy and access analytics across health/financial stores (breach-surface measurable and shrinking)
third-party risk tiers, access reviews and evidence automation (vendor assessments automated)
+20-30% capture with network analytics at stable SIU capacity
Combined-ratio contribution from loss adjustment expense

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: IFRS 17 / LDTI accounting and Solvency II / NAIC RBC regimes. reserving, capital and model governance under supervisory review. Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.
